lede: AI strategy execution helps professionals turn business priorities into practical plans for deploying and scaling AI systems. Designed for intermediate-level professionals leading AI initiatives, this course covers assessing data and systems readiness, scoring use cases by value and feasibility, and designing scalable AI architectures. Learners also create phased execution roadmaps and explore governance, monitoring, and ways to measure business impact.

prerequisites: This course is designed for intermediate-level professionals with working knowledge of AI concepts, data fundamentals, and business strategy. No coding or programming experience is required. Participants should have a laptop for hands-on exercises. Prior exposure to machine learning or data analytics is beneficial but not mandatory. The course focuses on strategic execution, architecture design, and roadmap development rather than technical model building.
